summary: Civista Bancshares filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Mark J. Sams as Senior Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer of both Civista Bancshares and Civista Bank. The event is an internal executive promotion, not a forced CEO/CFO/board departure; Sams led the same business lines since January 2026. No deal terms, advisor, premium, regulatory clock, or shareholder vote exist. Watch only routine integration and execution of growth strategy; no risk-arb angle applies.
